question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in past tense form.**

The declarations which come out from that office are not dependable.

options.text: The declarations which will come out from that office may not be dependable.
The declarations which come out from that office were not dependable.
The declarations which came out from that office are not dependable.
The declarations which came out from that office were not dependable.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The declarations which came out from that office were not dependable. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so we need to change the verb to its past tense form.
